footer.siteDescriptionShort: Create a digital experience that brings your guests together.

walkthrough.title: See How LYST Works
walkthrough.leadPrefix: The platform gives your guests a complete digital experience —
walkthrough.leadSuffix: that adapts to any screen and browser.
points: Opens instantly for guests — no app install
Full event details and location in one place
A live, interactive mode on the day of the event
walkthrough.showcaseText: Guests just enter their name and status to confirm. No account, no registration.

phases.title: It invites.
phases.text: Your guest gets everything they need on one personal link — location, dress code, and the full schedule.

phases.title: It comes alive.
phases.text: On the day itself, the link transforms: the camera and voice guestbook switch on, and guests become part of the story.

phases.title: It keeps the memory.
phases.text: Afterwards, every photo, message and moment is turned into a lasting, securely stored digital keepsake.

experiences.title: An experience, built with you
experiences.lead: Our studio in Tbilisi helps hosts build a unique digital atmosphere — a voice memory book, local photo printers and cameras, all synced to one lasting digital archive.

stats.title: Consultation

stats.title: Control

trust.title: Trust, backed by a real digital status
columns: No app required — runs right in the browser
One secure, personal link for the whole event
Hosts keep full control over who sees what

items.q: Does a guest need to download an app?
items.a: No — everything works straight from a mobile browser, with one simple link.

items.q: How do I add Voice Guestbook or Event Camera?
items.a: These are add-on modules we plan individually and activate after a consultation with our team.

items.q: When is the final price confirmed?
items.a: You'll see the invitation's price before it's published; for custom events, we put together a personal quote.

finalCta.lead: Start building your invitation now, or get in touch with us to plan a full digital experience.
